core.store.note: P1-02 ships the 0600 file store with surfaced failures and store_status() (file or indexeddb, degraded not-persistent); the Keychain binding is P5-05's and the Keystore binding P5-06's; no work package owns a desktop keyring.

config.resolve.note: OS.get_environment drops a leading U+FEFF from a value, so on a Godot host the two U+FEFF rows of config-matrix.json hold for the resolver, not for the process environment. A number's value is Godot's own reading, which is not correctly rounded, and a string value's \u0000 reads as U+FFFD (both WIRE-CONTRACT-V3 §10); verdicts are unaffected.

devices.fingerprint.note: PKeyFingerprint: per-platform readers as pure parsers over captured output, the capture on a WorkerThreadPool task once a session; the desktop device id hashes MachineGuid (Windows), IOPlatformUUID (macOS) and the rule-2 machine-id (Linux).

devices.report.note: The report also carries the Godot keys engine and outlet (the Worker bounds them; outlet is PKeyCore.reported_outlet()), and the updater's queued update events in updates (P6-03, P3-10).

identity.oidc.note: Native Godot has no completion path for the OIDC redirect; see P1-07, which ships device-code sign-in instead.

identity.devicecode.note: PolarisKey.identity (P1-07): begin_sign_in with background polling on the server's cadence, cancel, the opt-in confirm-identity step and licence attach, and a pure-GDScript QR encoder with PKeyQrRect for verification_uri_complete. On web it runs too (OS.shell_open becomes window.open; Worker CORS needed).

update.driver.note: P3-10: one adapter per outlet kind (distribution/outlets/, PKeyOutletAdapter): store kinds open the https listing or PKeyOptions.update_page_url, platform kinds stay silent with their own message, web reloads, direct dispatches binary.method to the Sparkle, Velopack, WinSparkle or AppImageUpdate bridge (a missing plugin degrades to the build's download link from distribution.endpoints.builds), stages a verified sidecar .pck (updater/sidecar_swap.gd, Range resume through PKeyDownload) and restarts into it without --main-pack. The native plugins are P5-07's; inert in the editor, headless runs and debug builds.

update.bootguard.note: P3-10: updater/slots.gd (staged, current, previous and state.json under user://pkey/<product>/updates/) and updater/boot_guard.gd, run in PKeyBoot's GUARD: bootGuardAction over the host's own count, a restart before guard.done after a swap or a rollback, two failed boots roll back and record skipVersion, BOOT_OK_SECONDS and confirm_boot() per the stage-matrix v2 confirmation rows; every copy is read back from disk before a swap or rollback. update_downloaded, update_applied, update_confirmed and boot_rolled_back go out on devices/report's updates key (P6-03's boundedUpdates shape), queued in state.json until reported.

outlet.detect.note: distribution/outlet.gd PKeyOutlet.detect_outlet over distribution/outlet_signals.gd (Flatpak, snap, AppImage, Steam library and environment, itch receipt, macOS receipt and Mach-O leaf, Caskroom, Windows path conventions, Android getInstallSourceInfo through JavaClassWrapper, web display mode); the iOS AppDistributor and Windows package readers are hooks that answer unavailable until P5-05 and a Windows native reader. PKeyCore.update_outlet() feeds the decision and PKeyCore.reported_outlet() the device report; PolarisKey.update.outlet() and detected() expose the result, as client.update.outlet and detected do in Node and Python.

packs.transport.apple.note: iOS goes through P5-05's plugin; no work package owns a macOS binding (program README §9).

packs.transport.msix.note: No work package owns an MSIX transport for Godot (program README §9).

packs.transport.flatpak.note: No work package owns a Flatpak transport for Godot (program README §9).

ui.stages.note: PKeyStages (core/stages.gd) replays every stage-matrix.json row, probe, guard and confirm case; PKeyBoot drives every row through PolarisKey.boot() with a scripted host (suite_boot).

ui.kit.note: P1-10's v1 kit: PKeyBoot, gate, activation panel, sign-in dialog with QR, offline activation, settings panel, status banner, update prompt, entitlement badge and dev-menu section, pinned as structural snapshots (suite_ui). PKeyDeviceList is not in v1 (unowned; needs P1-05) and the pack progress UI is P4-08's.
